name: aeon-skills
author: AntFleet
description: AntFleet skills for Aeon agents that run on-demand two-model-consensus PR reviews, paid in USDC on Base. One variant bills an installed repo's prepaid channel; the other uses x402 pay-per-call for public repos.
long_description_md:
## What it does

AntFleet's `aeon-skills` pack lets an Aeon agent trigger an on-demand, two-model-consensus pull-request review (Opus 4.7 + GPT-5) and pay for it in USDC on Base. It ships two skills covering two payment rails:

- **pr-review-antfleet** — Triggers a review on a specific `PR=<number>` or `SHA=<hex>` via AntFleet's installation endpoint (`POST /api/v1/installations/{id}/review`). The skill polls the async job until the consensus completes and writes a markdown report to `.outputs/pr-review-antfleet.md`. It debits the same prepaid USDC channel that funds AntFleet's automatic on-PR-open reviews — same price (default $0.50), same receipt flow, no new payment surface. Requires a wallet-bound AntFleet installation and `antfleet[bot]` installed on the repo.

- **pr-review-antfleet-x402** — A pull-mode variant for public repos that needs no AntFleet installation or prepaid channel. It uses the x402 402-sign-retry flow (`POST /api/v1/review/x402`) with EIP-3009 pay-per-call USDC. v1 access is restricted to aeon-ecosystem callers via the `X-Aeon-Context` header. Because the public path has no GitHub App permission, results are written to `.outputs/pr-review-antfleet-x402.md` without posting a PR comment.

## How it works

Both skills mint a single-use challenge, sign it with the operator's wallet key (`viem`, EIP-191 / EIP-3009), submit the review request, then poll every 10 seconds (up to 10 minutes) until the job reaches `complete` or `failed`. Reviews are idempotent — re-submitting the same `(installation, SHA)` pair or an explicit idempotency key returns the cached finding without re-debiting.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20+ (the pack uses ES modules and depends on `viem`).
- A funded wallet on Base and, for the channel variant, a bound AntFleet installation.
- Operator-set env vars (e.g. `ANTFLEET_INSTALLATION_ID`, `ANTFLEET_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY`, or `AEON_X402_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY` + `AEON_CONTEXT_TOKEN`).

## Notes

Skills are `default_enabled: false` and must be enabled explicitly. The repo declares MIT in its `package.json` and `skills-pack.json` manifests, though no standalone LICENSE file is present at the repo root.
